# Heartbeat (cron and job pings) (`source_type: heartbeat`)

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-probe-refs.ts from packages/probe-config. Do not edit by hand. -->

No probe. A job calls a private ping URL; Observer marks the metric late when the next successful ping does not arrive within the period plus the grace.

- Runs on: Observer Cloud, no agent (do not set `agent`)
- Thresholds: not used
- testProbe: not supported

## Value and unit

- `s`: seconds since the last successful ping

## source_config fields

| Field | Required | Type | Default | Limits |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `period_seconds` | yes | integer |  | 60 to 2678400 |
| `grace_seconds` | no | integer | `300` | 0 to 604800 |
| `max_runtime_seconds` | no | integer |  | 1 to 604800 |

## Rules

- Must not name an `agent`; thresholds are derived from `period_seconds` and `grace_seconds`.
- The schedule is an interval in seconds, not a cron expression: a daily job is 86400.
- The ping URL is a credential and is never part of a config document. Read it with getMetricHeartbeat; see the observer-heartbeats skill.

## Example

```yaml
source_type: heartbeat
source_config: {"period_seconds":86400,"grace_seconds":1800}
```
